predictions.claim: LLMs will be superseded by systems that learn continually from experience, in another instance of the Bitter Lesson.
predictions.speaker: Richard Sutton

predictions.claim: AI succession to digital or augmented intelligences is inevitable given no unified governance, eventual scientific understanding of intelligence, and the accumulation of power by the most intelligent agents.
predictions.speaker: Richard Sutton

predictions.claim: Cybersecurity — protecting an AI mind from corruption when integrating knowledge from spawned copies — will become a central problem in the era of digital intelligence.
predictions.speaker: Richard Sutton

predictions.claim: Current deep learning methods will continue to lack any built-in mechanism for good generalization or transfer until new algorithms explicitly target it.
predictions.speaker: Richard Sutton
